description: Defines the QuicSpdyClientSession class, a client-specific subclass of QuicSession for handling HTTP/3 over QUIC, including methods for stream creation, crypto handshake, and session management.

classes.name: QuicSpdyClientSession
classes.description: A client-specific subclass of QuicSpdyClientSessionBase for managing HTTP/3 over QUIC, including stream creation, crypto handshake, and session control.

methods.name: QuicSpdyClientSession
methods.description: Constructors initializing the session with configuration, connection, server ID, crypto config, and push promise index.

methods.name: Initialize
methods.description: Sets up the QuicSpdyClientSession, must be called before use.

methods.name: CreateOutgoingBidirectionalStream
methods.description: Creates a new outgoing bidirectional stream.

methods.name: CreateOutgoingUnidirectionalStream
methods.description: Creates a new outgoing unidirectional stream.

methods.name: GetMutableCryptoStream
methods.description: Returns a mutable pointer to the crypto stream.

methods.name: GetCryptoStream
methods.description: Returns a const pointer to the crypto stream.

methods.name: IsAuthorized
methods.description: Checks if the given authority is authorized.

methods.name: OnProofValid
methods.description: Handles a valid proof event.

methods.name: OnProofVerifyDetailsAvailable
methods.description: Handles available proof verification details.

methods.name: CryptoConnect
methods.description: Performs a crypto handshake with the server.

methods.name: GetNumSentClientHellos
methods.description: Returns the number of client hello messages sent.

methods.name: IsResumption
methods.description: Indicates if the handshake was a TLS resumption.

methods.name: EarlyDataAccepted
methods.description: Checks if early data was accepted.

methods.name: ReceivedInchoateReject
methods.description: Checks if the handshake was delayed due to server proof requirements.

methods.name: GetNumReceivedServerConfigUpdates
methods.description: Returns the number of server config updates received.

methods.name: set_respect_goaway
methods.description: Sets whether to respect GOAWAY frames.

methods.name: CreateIncomingStream
methods.description: Creates an incoming stream given a stream ID.

methods.name: CreateIncomingStream (PendingStream)
methods.description: Creates an incoming stream from a pending stream.

methods.name: ShouldCreateOutgoingBidirectionalStream
methods.description: Determines if an outgoing bidirectional stream should be created.

methods.name: ShouldCreateOutgoingUnidirectionalStream
methods.description: Determines if an outgoing unidirectional stream should be created.

methods.name: ShouldCreateIncomingStream
methods.description: Determines if an incoming stream can be created.

methods.name: CreateQuicCryptoStream
methods.description: Creates the crypto stream.

methods.name: CreateClientStream
methods.description: Creates a new client stream, possibly a subclass of QuicSpdyClientStream.
